article_title: The Effectiveness Level of Material Use in Classroom Instruction: A Meta-Analysis Study
citation: Zeynel KABLAN, Beyda TOPAN, Burak ERKAN. (2013). The Effectiveness Level of Material Use in Classroom Instruction: A Meta-analysis Study. Educational Sciences: Theory & Practice. https://doi.org/10.12738/estp.2013.3.1692
title: Meta-analysis corpus of 57 Turkish experimental studies on instructional material use (2000–2012)
description: A corpus of 57 experimental and quasi-experimental studies investigating the effectiveness of educational materials on academic achievement, drawn from national journal articles, theses and dissertations in the YÖK national thesis/dissertation centre, and conference papers. Studies were selected by explicit criteria, including that "Quasi-experimental and experimental studies that used educational materials in the experiment groups were included in this meta-analysis". Each study was coded on eight summary categories plus statistical information such as sample sizes, means and standard deviations.
requirements: Studies must report the statistical information necessary to calculate effect sizes
constraints: Limited to studies conducted in Turkey and published between 2000 and 2012; distance learning, computer-based learning and worksheet studies excluded; for studies with multiple experiment groups only the material-using group was included
examples: Data collection covered academic articles, YÖK thesis/dissertation records, and conference proceedings; 57 studies met all criteria and entered the analysis
key_sources: Zeynel KABLAN, Beyda TOPAN, Burak ERKAN. (2013). The Effectiveness Level of Material Use in Classroom Instruction: A Meta-analysis Study. Educational Sciences: Theory & Practice. https://doi.org/10.12738/estp.2013.3.1692
